title: The Gods of Born of the Gods

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: The god of city-states, building, industry, civic wisdom and scholarship, worshipped especially in Meletis.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The serene, wise god of the harvest, hearth and protection, strongly associated with Setessa, who governs the defense of home and territory.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The horned dark twin of Iroas, god of wrath and pain, who takes satisfaction in destroying his opponents utterly.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: The god Mogis's brother, who thrives on noble tests of mettle and the glory of victory.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: The god of cheats and liars, who governs gambling, deception, betrayal and secrets and is worshipped by criminals.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: The fifth god of Born of the Gods, discussed in the Planeswalker's Guide.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The polis where Ephara is particularly worshipped.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: The polis where worship of Karametra is strongest.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane with a pantheon of fifteen gods.

relations.note: Mogis is the dark twin of Iroas, and both govern the domain of war.
relations.quote: Mogis, the dark twin of the god Iroas, is the horned god of wrath and pain.

relations.note: She is the god of city-states and is particularly worshipped in Meletis.
relations.quote: in particular she is worshipped in Meletis.

relations.note: She is strongly associated with Setessa, where her worship is strongest.
